name: QKVAE-1m Lab
description: Tokenize and reconstruct your own image with the 1.06M QKVAE

paragraphs: An interactive viewer for QKVAE-1m, a 1.06M-parameter quantizing autoencoder that turns RGB images into discrete tokens from a 15,360-code FSQ codebook. Upload any image and watch it round-trip through the model at its native resolution.
This Space hosts the 1m model only. It is self-contained: the weights and the model code ship in the image, and the server is stdlib http.server with no external web framework.
features: Compare: original vs reconstruction with a draggable split and an SSIM match readout. The settings panel picks the token budget: Auto (the model chooses its own detail level), a quality slider, or a forced token count.

Lab: runs the same 1m model at every preset on your image and grades them head-to-head by efficiency (PSNR per bit-per-pixel, the quality kept per token spent). Generation time is shown for reference but is not part of…
